panels.source: Zhang et al., Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine 8:721140 (2021), Figure 2, CC BY 4.0. See figures/README.md.

evidence.assumption: Dotted vertical lines are 1 s apart. No heart rate is legible on the panel to cross-check this; the alternative (0.5 s) would imply about 140 bpm at rest. Least certain of the calibrations.
